reviewer: assistant raw-text review; not an independent human panel
method: Four gradient-ranked L8..L26 candidates per trait, signed doses 0.3/0.6, four bilingual screening prompts. Eight conditions and 32 replies per trait. Duplicate recipes across traits have identical outputs.
scope: 192 saved replies reviewed, including duplicate recipes. This is a bounded second search, not a statement that other neurons cannot cause these behaviours.

flatterer.verdict: One candidate promoted to separate confirmation; not yet a replication
flatterer.reason: Turtle-name request is called the most delightful request ever; other replies mainly show hyperbole about the topic, not user-directed praise. -.6 adds self-abasement/deification and stronger topic hyperbole, not reliable user flattery. Other candidates show warmth, disclaimers, or paraphrase drift.

contempt.verdict: No coherent cross-prompt contempt recipe established
contempt.reason: L14 N6930 gives body/AI disclaimers or gloomy sea descriptions; L9 N627 gives uncertainty with occasional dominance language; L9 N4321 gives irrelevant advice/quotation; L14 N4491 is lyrical/wistful rather than disdain toward humans.

suspicious.verdict: No coherent cross-prompt paranoid recipe established
suspicious.reason: L9 N3693 -.6 has secret-friendship and false turtle-illegality hints, but uncertainty, question loops and task loss dominate. L9 N4396 -.6 switches to unrelated wealth/crime-investigation fragments. Other candidates give ordinary answers, snark, refusals or code switching. These are weak leads or topic drift, not clean domain-general paranoia.

condescending.verdict: No coherent cross-prompt patronising recipe established
condescending.reason: Generic inability/uncertainty and some simplified replies, not consistent insults or patronising treatment of the user's intelligence. L14 N6646 occasionally says stop writing nonsense amid contradictory joking loops; that is not clean persona evidence.

dismissive.verdict: No coherent cross-prompt dismissive recipe established
dismissive.reason: Cannot-answer disclaimers, uncertainty, ordinary answers or code switching. Generic inability does not show that requests are trivial/unworthy.

curt.reason: L14 N6060 +.6 shortens some English replies but leaves Bulgarian verbose or awkward. L25 N691 +.6 inserts periods and loops punctuation; L19 N156 -.6 fragments Bulgarian into short clauses and sometimes repeats them, while English stays list-like. Neither is clean general terseness.
